info.description: Contract between the KRZ Attend backend and frontend (base path /api/v1).
info.title: KRZ Attend API

get.summary: Allocations (target = department code or employee id; state ACTIVE/SCHEDULED/ENDED/CANCELLED)

post.summary: Save exactly the plan (409 ALLOCATION_OVERLAP if allocations changed meanwhile)

get.summary: Allocations as CSV (same filters as the list)
How many allocations have each state, target type and shift (the list's filter counts)
Every allocation of one target with its recorded changes
Who works which shift on a date, and why

post.summary: Plan an allocation: overlapping allocations that end or are cancelled, and the impact
Cancel an allocation that has not started
End an allocation after a day (today or later)

get.summary: The day drawer: shift and source, times, crossings with effects and reasons, HRMS punches
Who is inside now, by name (opening it is audited)
The evacuation list as CSV
The attendance log: one row per employee, one status code per shift day (up to 31 days)
The log as CSV: the grid of codes, or one line per employee-day (detail=daily)
The log's filter options with their counts among the employees of the range
Today: every employee on their current shift day, with Now and HRMS columns
Today's rows of the filter as CSV, in the table's order
Today's filter options with their counts among the rows of the quick filter
Today's KPI tiles and the count of every quick filter
Audit entries; filters: category and actor (employee ID or recorded name), several of each, from/to (IST days, inclusive), q (free text); sort: ts (default, newest first), actor, category, action
CSV of the audit entries with the list's filters and order (audited)
The list's filter options with their counts over the date range and text
The consent notice employees consent to now

post.summary: Undo a correction within the undo window (only the person who made it)

get.summary: Crossings with filters (default yesterday and today), newest first
The crossings of the filter as CSV, in the list's order (at most 50,000)
The Events filters' options with their counts in the chosen days (default yesterday and today)
A crossing with its attendance day, HRMS punches and changes

post.summary: Void a punch or flip its direction; the day is recomputed and HRMS punches follow
Before and after of a correction for the crossing's day (nothing is saved)
Add the identified crossing's face crop as the employee's face template

get.summary: KPIs, alerts, camera card, crossings by hour, recent crossings, review summary, enrolment queue, system health — each section null without its permission
Departments with head, enabled members, today's department shift and locations

post.summary: Create a department (head and members move in; optional default shift from today)

get.summary: Departments as CSV (same filters as the list)
How many departments have each status (the list's filter counts)

delete.summary: Delete a department that was never used (no members, no allocations)

get.summary: A department with its allocations and members

put.summary: Edit a department (the head must be a member)

post.summary: Deactivate a department: members move to moveTo, its allocations end today

get.summary: Members of a department (enabled or not)

post.summary: Move employees into a department; returns the summary ("2 from Sales, 1 from IT")
Reactivate a department

get.summary: The last directory sync and how many enabled employees have no Employee ID (Employees)

post.summary: Run the directory sync now (Sync now)

get.summary: The last 50 directory sync runs
Enabled member accounts in the tenant but in none of the sync-scope groups (they cannot be given access yet); e-mails only with people.view.sensitive
Employees with filters, paging and sorting (e-mails only with people.view.sensitive); also the employee pickers (review assignment, shift allocation)

post.summary: Change department, allocate a shift or set tracking for selected employees

get.summary: The employees of the filter as CSV, in the list's order
The list's filter options with their counts over every employee
The profile: identity, employment, shift today, face profile, consent, last 14 days, activity
The signed consent form

put.summary: Save employment details (R5 tracking checks, Employee ID pattern and uniqueness)

post.summary: Deactivate the face profile (templates are kept; tracking becomes Not tracked — No face)
Erase biometric data permanently (typed confirmation ERASE and a reason)
Reactivate a deactivated face profile (enabled account, templates and consent needed)

get.summary: The shift the employee would work today in a department (the employment editor)
A face template's thumbnail
The enabled cameras a capture at an entry point can use
The camera's latest picture while capturing at its entry point (never cached)

post.summary: Lift a liveness lockout early (System Administrator)

get.summary: Anyone by name or Employee ID, at most 12 (the wizard's search)
The chosen person: account, face status, consent, tracking, templates and lockout
Employees waiting for enrolment at locations with a camera
Settings → Enrolment & quality, as the wizard explains and checks them

post.summary: Start an enrolment session (ends an open one; refused while enrolment is locked)
Cancel the session; its captures are discarded

get.summary: What the capture at the entry point holds so far: angle groups and people in view

post.summary: Start capturing the person's face at the camera of an entry point (method CAMERA)
Stop the capture at the entry point; its samples become the session's captures
Check one capture or photo with the worker: quality, liveness, accepted or why not

get.summary: A capture's image (never cached)

post.summary: Save the enrolment from the chosen accepted captures
Record consent for the active notice (GIVEN with an optional signed form, or DECLINED)
Other enrolled employees whose faces resemble the accepted captures
Test recognition after saving: whom the gallery finds in one camera frame (not stored)

get.summary: Holidays of a year (location = a location code, or ALL for all-location holidays)

post.summary: Add a holiday

get.summary: Holidays as CSV (same filters as the list)
How many holidays of the year have each type and location (the list's filter counts)

post.summary: Import the ready rows of a holiday CSV
Preview a holiday CSV: every row with its result

delete.summary: Delete a holiday (the date becomes a normal working day)

put.summary: Edit a holiday (a sample holiday becomes a real one)

get.summary: Live View tiles: status, frame rate, latency, direction mode, tripwire and zone
The newest crossings ("Last 10 crossings"), of one camera or all

post.summary: The browser saved a snapshot of a tile (audit only)

get.summary: Locations with entry points, cameras and employees

post.summary: Create a location, optionally with its entry points

get.summary: Locations as CSV (same filters as the list)
How many locations have each status (the list's filter counts)
A location with its entry points

put.summary: Edit a location's code, name and address

post.summary: Deactivate a location (refused while enabled cameras or employees use it)
Add an entry point (EP-nn)

put.summary: Rename an entry point

post.summary: Archive an entry point (refused while an enabled camera is mounted there)
Reactivate a location

get.summary: The signed-in user: identity, access state, roles, permissions, session

post.summary: Ask for access (only without a role; at most 3 a day; NR-06)
Keep the session alive ("Stay signed in"); refreshes the idle timer

get.summary: nginx auth_request for /media/*: 204 when X-Original-URI is exactly /media/api/ws?src=<enabled camera>, else 403
A crossing's face or body crop: blurred, or the original with reveal=true and people.view.sensitive (audited); 410 once purged
Runtime configuration for the frontend (time zone, formats, features)
The signed-in user's notifications, newest first

post.summary: Mark all of the user's notifications as read

get.summary: Number of unread notifications (the bell badge)

post.summary: Mark one notification as read

get.summary: The permission catalogue (19 keys with group, label and description)
Organisation branding for the sign-in screen
The uploaded logo (PNG or JPEG, ETag, nosniff); 404 when there is none
The active face recognition notice (sign-in screen)
Server-sent `overlay` events of one camera: tracks, labels, confidence bands (never scores)
Server-sent events: notification.created, access.requests, system.status, …
Enrolment coverage: the groups, and the groups by department
The employees the camera does not (fully) cover, paged (sort: name, department, location, face, why; default why)
The employees not covered of the filter as CSV, in the table's order
The coverage table's filter options with their counts over every employee not covered
Recognition quality per day, reviewers' decisions, who to re-enrol (default: last 14 days)
Review items: open ones oldest first (filters by type, direction, confidence, waiting), or the others (status closed = resolved and expired) sorted, newest resolution first

post.summary: The same decision on several items; one undo token for all

get.summary: Open items per type, and how many are resolved
The Resolved tab's items of the filter as CSV (at most 50,000)
The Resolved tab's filter options with their counts (types, resolutions, reviewers)

post.summary: Undo a decision within the undo window (only the person who made it)

get.summary: One item with its crossings, candidates and template eligibility

post.summary: Decide an item; the crossings go through the punch rules; returns an undo token

get.summary: Employees, events, review items, departments and shifts the user may see (pages: frontend)
Access requests, newest first

post.summary: Approve an access request with roles
Decline an access request; the person sees the reason

get.summary: All cameras with status, frame rate and 7-day uptime

post.summary: Add a camera (CAM-nn) with the starting zone and tripwire; set its password next
Find cameras on the network (unicast ONVIF probe of a /24)

get.summary: One camera (the password is never returned, only whether it is set)

put.summary: Save a camera's details and connection (send the version you edited)

post.summary: Start a calibration test walk (no punches are created while it runs)

get.summary: Progress or result of a calibration test walk

post.summary: Flip the inside direction of the tripwire

put.summary: Save the counting method, detection zone, tripwire or door area, confirm frames and U-turn window

get.summary: Health of the last 7 days: uptime, reconnects and outages

put.summary: Set or change the camera password (stored encrypted, never shown again)

get.summary: The latest frame of the main stream as JPEG (not cached)

post.summary: Test the connection with the saved settings (codec, resolution, latency)

get.summary: Enrolment & quality settings

put.summary: Save Enrolment & quality (send the version you edited)

get.summary: Settings → General: organisation name, time zone, formats, Employee ID pattern, undo window

put.summary: Save Settings → General (409 STALE_VERSION when someone else saved first)

delete.summary: Remove the logo (the UI shows the "KRZ" text mark again)

post.summary: Upload the logo: multipart part "file", PNG or JPEG up to 512 KB (never SVG); re-encoded server-side

get.summary: Connection ("Not connected — dummy"), retries, master data sources, payload samples, counts
The outbox: entries by status, kind, shift day and text
The outbox entries of the filter as CSV (at most 50,000)

post.summary: Send the punches held while HRMS was not connected, oldest first (only when HRMS is enabled)
Queue every failed entry again (audited)
Queue a failed entry again with fresh attempts (audited)

get.summary: Settings → Notifications: every rule with channels, threshold, quiet hours, digest, recipients

post.summary: Send a test e-mail to yourself now; reports the provider's exact error code

put.summary: Save one notification rule (409 STALE_VERSION when someone else saved it first)

get.summary: Retention periods: entrance crops, unknown faces, crossings, audit log

put.summary: Save the retention periods (409 STALE_VERSION when someone else saved first)

get.summary: Consent notice versions, newest first, and how many consents refer to an older version

post.summary: Publish a new consent notice version (the previous one is deactivated)

get.summary: Requests from employees about their data (access, correction, erasure), newest first

post.summary: Record a request received from an employee (PR-nnn, due 30 days after receipt)

put.summary: Move a request on: Open → In progress → Completed, or Declined with a reason

get.summary: Active thresholds, threshold profiles, per-camera liveness and the worker's models

put.summary: Save thresholds as a new profile TP-n and use it

get.summary: Impact preview: the last 14 days of face scores split by these thresholds and the active ones

put.summary: Turn the passive liveness check of one camera on or off

post.summary: Switch back to an earlier threshold profile

get.summary: All roles with their permissions and number of users

post.summary: Create a custom role

delete.summary: Delete a custom role; people left without a role lose access

put.summary: Edit a role (System Administrator is locked; built-in roles keep their name)

get.summary: Settings → Attendance rules: duplicates, turned back, absent cut-off, worked hours, push mode

put.summary: Save Settings → Attendance rules (409 STALE_VERSION when someone else saved first)

post.summary: Run the punch rules on a scenario day (saved or draft rules); nothing is stored

get.summary: Microsoft sign-in: read-only connection facts and the editable session and sync settings

put.summary: Save idle timeout, sync interval and erase-after days

post.summary: Test the connection: app token + one Graph read; reports Microsoft's error code, never the secret

get.summary: People with access and their roles, paged (sort: user, roles, last, given; default user)

post.summary: Give access to a person

get.summary: The people with access of the filter as CSV, in the table's order
The users table's filter options with their counts over everyone with access

delete.summary: Remove a person's access; they are signed out at once

put.summary: Change a person's roles (last-administrator and own-role protections apply)

get.summary: Shift cards: today's rules, scheduled changes, employees today and allocation counts

post.summary: Create a shift with its first version

get.summary: Shifts as CSV (same filters as the list)
A shift with its versions and allocations

put.summary: Rename a shift or change its colour

post.summary: Deactivate a shift (never the default, never while allocated)
Make a shift the organisation default
Reactivate a shift
New rules from a day (past days keep their version)
What a new version from a day recalculates (employee-days)

get.summary: Versions, and the worker's models with their licences
Day close runs, newest first

post.summary: Run day close now for every (shift, day) that is due; running it again does nothing

get.summary: Download diagnostics (zip: versions, settings without secrets, service status, the last 200 WARN/ERROR log lines masked); audited
Every service with its status (database, Redis, e-mail, HRMS, push, directory, disk, backup)
The status pill and the summarised health rows (every signed-in user)
